content: Ofinththan kawoti olas keziza wode Iyo7aabey olanchchata kaaleththi biidi Amoone dere dhayssides; Eraabe katamaakka dooddi uttides; gido attiin Dawiti Yerusalaamen takkides; Iyo7aabey Eraaba katama oli laallides.

Hessafe guye Dawiti yiidi istta kawoza hu7eppe worqqa kallachcha ekkides; kallachchazi 34 kilo giraame gidides; iza giddon inqqu geetettiza al7o shuchchi dees; he kallachchaa ekkidi Dawite hu7en goxxida; qasse Dawiti he katamaappe keehi daro miish di7i ekkides.

Heen de7iza deraa kessidi magaaze, xoyllenne kaltta oyththi oosisides; Amoonen diza hara katamatan diza asatakka Dawiti hessaththo oosisides; hessafe guye Dawitinne iza olanchchati ubbay Yerusalaame simmida.
Hessafe simmiin Filisxeeme asatara Gezeeren olay dendides; he wode Huushe dere as Sibikayey Erafayme zere gidida Sifaye wodhides; histtiin Filisxeemeti xoonettida.
Hessafe guye Filisxeemetara hara olay dendides; he wode izi oykkiza tooraa toomay shammaane wondiraashe keena gidida Geete katamappe yida Golyaade isha Lahiime Ya7ire naa Elyaaney wodhides.
Qasseka hara olay Geete kataman dendides; heen izas kusheninne tohon usuppun usuppun biradhdheti issi bolla 24 biradhdheti diza Erafaye zereththafe gidida gubbanne geesa adussa asi dees.
He addezi Isra7eeleta bolla eqettida wode Dawite isha Shim7a naa Yoonataaney iza wodhides.
Haytanti Geete kataman diza Erafaye zareta; istti ubbay Dawite kusheninne iza asaa kushen hayqqida.
